root_cause_analysis.violation_01: Fallback metadata and text compilation injected into raw artifact (page.txt) when live network navigation timed out/failed.
root_cause_analysis.violation_02: Synthetic fallback HTML constructed from placeholder template when document.content() was empty.
root_cause_analysis.violation_03: HTTP status defaulted to 200 in capture receipt despite absence of authentic HTTP response from target server.
root_cause_analysis.violation_04: Lotte Cinema miscategorized under Ngũ Hành Sơn despite receipt indicating Hải Châu / border.
root_cause_analysis.violation_05: Claimed '22 Cobalt locations 100% physically captured on disk' while 4 entries were synthetic reconstructions.

containment_actions_taken.rule: If no live HTTP response, no live DOM, or no real screenshot -> mark FAILED_CAPTURE; throw error/exit non-zero; never inject fallback metadata into raw artifacts; never default HTTP 200.
